tooltip.curiosabilityaddon.probability_l: While equipped, increases every built-in chance-based ability by 30 percentage points.
tooltip.curiosabilityaddon.combat_charm: While equipped, boosts critical, dodge, and counter chances by 20 points and grants Strength I.
tooltip.curiosabilityaddon.harvest_charm: While equipped, boosts crop growth and grass mineral chances by 25 points and grants Haste I and Luck I.
tooltip.curiosabilityaddon.treasure_char: While equipped, boosts double drops and free enchant chances by 25 points and grants Luck II.
tooltip.curiosabilityaddon.vitality_char: While equipped, grants Regeneration I and Resistance I.
tooltip.curiosabilityaddon.agility_charm: While equipped, grants Speed II and Jump Boost I.
